curl is part of 2 of my public repositories, from 2015 to 2020.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1) and [Learning and experiments](@/projects/learning.md) (1).

Most recently: [ctu-cz](@/work/ctu-cz.md): Otevrena data ceskeho telekomunikacniho uradu; [grache-test](@/work/grache-test.md): Test project for grache.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses curl: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links curl to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
